label: Diagram 1.2
caption: Diagram 1.2 Minimum door width, hall widths and localised obstructions
description:
A plan of corridors and doors, showing minimum door widths, hall widths and where localised obstructions are allowed. '*all dimensions are minimum except where noted'.

Two doors open off the corridors along the top, with clear widths of '775mm' and '800mm'; a third door, at the right-hand end, is '750mm'. A door at the bottom is also '750mm'.

The left-hand corridor is '1050mm' wide, or '900mm' beside a permitted obstruction (a dashed box) of '2m max.' length. The middle corridor is '900mm' wide, or '750mm' beside a permitted obstruction, again '2m max.'. The corridor at the bottom is '1200mm' wide in front of its door.

In the key, grey shading in front of the doors marks 'Localised obstruction not permitted in shaded zone', and the dashed box a 'Permitted obstruction'.
model_description:
This diagram, titled "Diagram 1.2 Minimum door width, hall widths and localised obstructions," consists of a floor plan showing various door openings and hallway widths. A note at the bottom states, "*all dimensions are minimum except where noted".

The plan illustrates three door scenarios and a hallway. The first door on the left shows a clear opening width of 750mm, with a total width of 900mm including the door leaf. Adjacent to this door is a hallway with a width of 1050mm, which contains a shaded area labelled "Localised obstruction not permitted in shaded zone". This shaded area is located within a 2m max. length.

The second door shows a clear opening of 750mm and a total width of 800mm. Next to it is a hallway with a width of 900mm, containing a dashed rectangle labelled "Permitted obstruction" within a 2m max. length. 

The third door, shown at the bottom, has a clear opening of 750mm and a total width of 1200mm. This door opens into a space with a 900mm width.
